candidate_datasets.source: Datastream / LSEG digital asset series, if licensed
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Potential independent BTC/ETH prices, index series, and cross-venue macro-aligned timestamps.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Coverage and identifiers depend on the institution's Datastream/LSEG license; WRDS is not usually the best source for crypto-native OHLCV.

candidate_datasets.source: Refinitiv Datastream / LSEG cross-asset time series
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Single source for broad macro/risk-regime inputs that can be lagged and merged with crypto daily bars.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Symbol mapping must be versioned; vendor revisions and holidays need explicit treatment.

candidate_datasets.source: FRED, Federal Reserve, BEA/BLS, or Datastream macro series through WRDS
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Macro liquidity and risk-regime features: liquidity impulse, inflation/rates pressure, economic stress.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Low-frequency macro data is released with delays and revisions; use release calendars or conservative lags.

candidate_datasets.source: USD index and major FX series from Datastream/LSEG or FRED
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Crypto often trades as a high-beta anti-USD liquidity asset; USD uptrends can gate risk down.
candidate_datasets.limitation: FX data helps regime filtering but is not crypto-specific.

candidate_datasets.source: Treasury, SOFR/Fed funds, real yield, and yield-curve series
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Rates trend and real-rate shocks can identify hostile conditions for speculative assets.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Daily rates are useful; macro release data must be lagged to avoid revision leakage.

candidate_datasets.source: Gold, copper, oil, broad commodity indices
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Commodity trends can proxy inflation, growth, and risk sentiment; gold/BTC interaction may be relevant.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Commodity signals are indirect and can add noise if used without a predeclared regime rule.

candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Risk-on/risk-off gate: equity trend, drawdown, breadth, and realized volatility.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Equity data is useful for regime, not as a direct crypto alpha source.

candidate_datasets.source: CBOE VIX/VVIX or Datastream volatility index series
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Volatility shock filter: reduce crypto exposure when VIX is high or rapidly rising.
candidate_datasets.limitation: VIX reflects equity options, not crypto options; still useful as a global risk proxy.

candidate_datasets.source: ETF Global, CRSP mutual fund/ETF, Lipper, or fund-holdings data if licensed
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Institutional flow proxy, especially for spot BTC/ETH ETFs if covered after launch.
candidate_datasets.limitation: WRDS ETF flow coverage may not include crypto ETFs or may arrive with delays unsuitable for weekly trading.

candidate_datasets.source: RavenPack or other licensed news sentiment on WRDS
candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Risk-event filter and sentiment confirmation if crypto entities or broad market risk topics are covered.
candidate_datasets.limitation: News is high-dimensional, licensed, timestamp-sensitive, and easy to overfit.

candidate_datasets.crypto_relevance: Equity/index options can provide implied-risk features; crypto options are unlikely unless specifically licensed elsewhere.
candidate_datasets.limitation: Useful for market-regime filters, but not a substitute for Deribit-style crypto implied volatility.

feature_plan.wrds_source: Datastream/LSEG, FRED/FRB macro series if accessible
feature_plan.example_features: financial-conditions z-score; recession/stress proxy; release-lagged macro surprise where available
feature_plan.trading_use: Permit crypto exposure only outside broad macro stress.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Use publication/release lags; do not use revised values at original dates without point-in-time vintages.

feature_plan.wrds_source: DXY/broad USD from Datastream/LSEG or FRED; money-market/rates series
feature_plan.example_features: DXY 50/200-day trend; 20-day USD momentum; liquidity impulse proxy
feature_plan.trading_use: Reduce BTC/ETH exposure during strong USD/liquidity-tightening regimes.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Daily series lagged one trading day; macro proxies lagged by release schedule.

feature_plan.wrds_source: Treasury, Fed funds, SOFR, real yields from FRED/FRB/Datastream
feature_plan.example_features: 2Y and 10Y yield trend; 10Y real-yield change; yield-curve slope
feature_plan.trading_use: Identify tightening shocks that historically pressure high-duration risk assets.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Use prior close or conservative one-day lag.

feature_plan.example_features: S&P 500 above 200-day average; Nasdaq 30-day momentum; equity drawdown
feature_plan.trading_use: Gate crypto risk when equities are in confirmed uptrends.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Align to crypto decision timestamp; lag one day because crypto trades 24/7.

feature_plan.example_features: gold trend; copper/gold ratio; oil shock filter; broad commodity momentum
feature_plan.trading_use: Differentiate inflation shocks, growth risk, and safe-haven regimes.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Daily lag; predeclare transformations to avoid narrative fitting.

feature_plan.wrds_source: CBOE/Datastream VIX, VVIX, MOVE if licensed
feature_plan.example_features: VIX level percentile; 5-day VIX change; volatility shock dummy
feature_plan.trading_use: Risk-off gate or position-size reduction during volatility shocks.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Use only observations known before rebalance.

feature_plan.wrds_source: ETF Global, CRSP mutual fund/ETF, Lipper, holdings databases if licensed
feature_plan.example_features: BTC ETF AUM/flow change; crypto-equity ETF flow; institutional demand proxy
feature_plan.trading_use: Confirm risk-on exposure if spot ETF flow data is timely and complete.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Use actual report availability dates; assume stale if only monthly/quarterly.

feature_plan.example_features: crypto entity sentiment; macro risk sentiment; novelty-weighted negative-news shock
feature_plan.trading_use: Avoid exposure during broad negative event clusters; do not use as a standalone alpha yet.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Use timestamped news only; aggregate before rebalance cut-off.

feature_plan.example_features: SPY/QQQ implied volatility; skew; term-structure slope; VIX/VVIX
feature_plan.trading_use: Forward-looking risk proxy for macro-conditioned crypto exposure.
feature_plan.leakage_control: Lag option metrics and ensure no post-close values enter same-day crypto decisions.
